title: O&O ShutUp10 – The antispy tool for Windows 10 and 11
summary: O&O ShutUp10 is a free privacy control utility for Windows 10 and 11 that provides a centralized interface to manage Windows telemetry, data collection, and spy features without requiring registry edits or complex group policy changes.
problem_solved: It solves the problem of Windows collecting user data and telemetry without easy opt-out options, giving users granular control over their privacy settings.
why_valuable: It provides free, accessible privacy protection for Windows users who want to disable telemetry without technical registry knowledge.
